question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

Ramesh always __blows his own trumpet.__
solution:
The correct answer is: **praises himself**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom **"blows his own trumpet"** means to boast about oneself or to praise oneself excessively. (अपनी प्रशंसा करना)

 
 
• **Example: **Ramesh always blows his own trumpet, talking about his achievements at every opportunity.
 
 
 
• **"praises himself"** means to speak highly of oneself, often to draw attention to one's own accomplishments. (अपनी प्रशंसा करना)
 
 
• **Example: **She never misses a chance to praise herself for her cooking skills.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **praises himself**.
